messages:
alex_cheng: Heads-up — AcmePayments wants a short POC for streaming responses + tool/function calls + structured JSON output. They want clear SDK examples, handshake steps for their proxy, a rough pricing estimate for 10k reqs/day, and answers for the security questionnaire. Can eng/presales own the checklist this week?

santhosh_r: I can own the runbook. Quick q: expected QPS peak? Are they latency-sensitive (<200ms) or throughput-first? Also are they using embeddings in the loop or just generation + tool calls?

alex_cheng: They said 30 reqs/s peak, 99th p90 latency target ~250ms, no embeddings for now — just structured invoices out + a webhook to their downstream system.

maria_sec: Re: security qns — need to confirm: data residency (EU), KMS for key management, and whether customer-managed VPC required. Also send me the signed DPA template early.
jane_prod: SDK note: structured output + function-calls are supported in SDK v0.9+. For streaming function-calls use the streaming websocket or SSE path. Small Node example (stream + func call):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream.create({ model: 'redwood-stream-1', input: 'parse invoice', functions });
for await (const part of stream) { console.log(part.json ?? part.delta); }
```
If they need strictly typed JSON, enable schema validation flag in the request. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/streaming

santhosh_r: Will add handshake snippet for their proxy (they use mutual TLS). Proposed flow: 1) short-lived creds from our IAM, 2) mTLS between adapter and their proxy, 3) fallback to hosted via OAuth for dev. 

alex_cheng: Pricing ask: Can we give a back-of-envelope for 10k requests/day with avg 80 tokens/request? What tier should we quote for Dedicated vs Hosted?

jane_prod: Back-of-envelope: Hosted: ~10k * 80 tokens = 800k tokens/day. At our public dev rate that maps to ~$X/day (I'll pull exact numbers), but for enterprise POC we usually quote a temporary discounted pilot rate and recommend Dedicated if they need consistent latency and isolation. I'll ping finance for a sample pilot quote.

maria_sec: For security questionnaire — I'll draft standard answers. Need to know whether customer wants HSM-backed KMS and whether logs can be routed to their SIEM (we support syslog / customer webhook).

santhosh_r: I'm attaching a small checklist I'll use in the POC runbook:
- env: sample mTLS certs + short-lived creds
- sdk: node + go examples (structured output + streaming)
- handshake: proxy healthcheck endpoint + retry/backoff config
- test plan: 1k warmup -> ramp to 30 qps -> validate 250ms p99
- monitoring: provide dashboard link + token-level cost estimates

alex_cheng: Perfect. Can we also get a short demo script (5–7 min) for the customer call on Friday? I can run through the streaming demo and function call.

jane_prod: I'll prepare a 6-min script and a minimal repo. Will include: curl streaming sample, Node stream, and structured output validator.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for branch presales/poc-checklist succeeded: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4521 :white_check_mark:

maria_sec: I'll email the DPA template and a preliminary security answers doc by EOD. @santhosh_r please add the mTLS cert rotation steps into the runbook.

santhosh_r: Will do. Planning to have the initial runbook + demo repo link posted here by tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
